p63.character: an application-level low-yield outcome from a host that was reached and answered

nat64RuleDoesNotApplyToP64.why: the rule's clause 1 requires a pre-socket BLOCKED_BY_POLICY refusal by the landed address classifier over an address that resolution DID return. P:64 returned no address at all. A resolution failure and a refusal of a translated address are different observations, and conflating them would let an ordinary unreachable host be written off as an environment artefact

whatThatConclusionMeans: human review of the pause occurred
no shared engine, policy or persistence defect is established by these two items
a NEW window may start with fresh window-local P1/P2/P3/P5 state
whatThatConclusionDoesNotMean: it does NOT mean either failure is ignored - both created Q1 obligations and both are served first in the next window
it does NOT mean P5 was false - the pause was correct and is not retroactively reclassified
it does NOT mean either target should be retried - neither is retried; each slot is served by its next frozen reserve
it does NOT predict that the remaining corpus performs similarly - 2 low-yield items of 5 supports no such inference, and none is drawn

stateThisContinuationStartsFrom.recomputationMethod: every committed A2 record carrying a per-slot acquisition verdict was parsed, its verdicts applied to a 110-entry status map in recordedAtUtc order, and the map counted per class with disjointness and full coverage asserted. Heterogeneous verdict fields were handled explicitly (verdict, finalAdjudication, adjudication.finalAcquisitionOutcome, finalCurrentStatus, finalSd9, newAcquisitionOfRecord.sd9, resolution.pNN.finalAcquisitionOutcome) and an item whose verdict could not be classified would have ABORTED the derivation rather than been skipped. The replacement ledger was validated with the landed harness and every Q1 occupant derived with currentOccupantForSelectionIndex. Nothing was taken from the owner task text and nothing from an adapter-held count
stateThisContinuationStartsFrom.q1Order: 63 -> 64, by ascending selectionIndex per Owner Clarification Q1

p6.evaluation: 22 > 10 is TRUE and 62 < 50 is FALSE; the conjunction is false

stateThisContinuationStartsFrom.doNotExtrapolate: 62 successful slots of 110; not a population success rate

p59DoesNotEnterQ1Now.whyItIsExcluded: frozen Q1 says: at a bounded-window planning point, collect the PENDING REPLACEMENT OBLIGATIONS, sort those ACTUAL obligations by selectionIndex ascending, and assign the next unused reserves monotonically. P:59 holds no obligation, so there is nothing for Q1 to sort or serve

theCounterfactualIsRefusedExplicitly.counterfactual: if P:59 later fails, 59 < 63, so it should be queued ahead of 63 now
theCounterfactualIsRefusedExplicitly.why: that obligation does not yet exist. Q1 orders obligations, not hypotheses, and inserting a slot on the strength of a failure it has not received would manufacture an obligation the evidence does not support

ifItLaterReceivesAnOwnerFailureAdjudicat: include it in the Q1 queue at the NEXT planning point
do NOT retroactively reorder or revoke an already-consumed reserve
p59DoesNotEnterQ1Now.authorisedActionsUnderThisRecord: none. P:59 is not rerun, not replaced, not classified, and no Jaccard-on-empty treatment, minimum token count, short-text uniqueness rule, short-text duplicate status or forced survivor count is invented for it
p59DoesNotEnterQ1Now.ifItBecomesNecessaryToDetermineCorpusClo: STOP and return to the owner

newBoundedAuthority.windowSize: 5 whenever at least five executable items remain
newBoundedAuthority.whyFullSizeIsCharged: the cap bounds AUTHORISED exposure, not items actually executed. A window that pauses on P5 after three items still spends its authorised five
newBoundedAuthority.afterTheFourthOrdinaryWindowIsAdjudicate: STOP for owner review regardless of state. There is no fifth window under this record
newBoundedAuthority.afterTwentyLiveAttemptsAreCharged: STOP for owner review regardless of state, even if fewer than four windows have run

windowConstructionAlgorithm.name: DETERMINATE_Q1_REPLACEMENTS_BEFORE_NEW_PRIMARIES
steps: STEP 1 - independently recompute the ACTUAL current pending replacement obligations from the committed adjudication chain and the database, never from a carried-forward total and never from the adapter
STEP 2 - sort those actual obligations by selectionIndex ASCENDING, per Owner Clarification Q1
STEP 3 - assign the next unused reserve positions monotonically in frozen reserve-rank order
STEP 4 - take the replacement work items FIRST
STEP 5 - fill any remaining positions with NEVER_STARTED primaries in ascending selectionIndex order, excluding P:59
STEP 6 - use five items whenever at least five executable items remain

splitsCrossChecked.source: recomputed directly from the frozen draw bytes, not copied from the owner task text

laterWindowsAreNotPrecommittedHere.why: each window's own outcomes decide the next window's obligations. Precommitting a later composition now would repeat the error the Window-01 adjudication warned about, when a failed replacement sorted ahead of the slots an illustrative 'next window' had named

strategyAdapterLimitation.finding: the landed strategy-to-spec adapter does not know acquisition outcomes. It validates structure, digests, split agreement, reserve ordering and ledger binding, and it will ACCEPT a structurally valid strategy that re-serves an already-SUCCESSFUL selection slot
strategyAdapterLimitation.consequence: ADAPTER ACCEPTANCE IS NEVER SUFFICIENT STRATEGY AUTHORITY
mandatoryIndependentGovernanceForEverySt: independently derive the current ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL set from the adjudication chain
independently derive the current CURRENT_ACQUISITION_FAILURE set
independently derive the current PENDING_CAPABILITY_REVIEW set
independently derive the current NEVER_STARTED set
independently derive the current Q1 pending replacement obligations
require every replacement selectionIndex to be an ACTUAL current pending replacement obligation
require every primary selectionIndex to be an ACTUAL current NEVER_STARTED slot

aCandidateReferencingAnAlreadySuccessful.andTheRefusalMustBeProvedForTheRightReas: a negative probe must use CORRECT draw-entry digests for at least one already-successful slot, so that the refusal is demonstrably a current-state refusal and not an incidental digest mismatch

hostEventMonitoringMethodCorrection.whatIsNowForbidden: using absolute pmset event-count monotonicity as evidence that no Sleep/Wake/DarkWake event occurred
hostEventMonitoringMethodCorrection.why: the pmset log may rotate or truncate at its tail, so the TOTAL event count can DECREASE without any new event. A count delta is therefore not a sound predicate over a governed interval
canonicalTestFromNowOn: capture the governed interval START timestamp before the governed work begins
inspect the ACTUAL Sleep / Wake / DarkWake event timestamps in the pmset log
ask whether any qualifying event timestamp lies INSIDE the governed interval [start, end]
hostEventMonitoringMethodCorrection.failClosed: an event whose type field begins Sleep, Wake or DarkWake counts, including 'Wake Requests'. Matching conservatively is deliberate: a false alarm costs a review, a missed wake costs evidence integrity

networkPreconditionPersists.requirement: before EVERY ordinary live window under this authority, and again before EVERY live item inside it, prove the active acquisition vantage is not the previously identified unsuitable DNS64/NAT64-only condition
networkPreconditionPersists.method: public-safe non-institution canaries plus the gateway's own resolution and classification path - dns.promises.lookup(host, { all: true, verbatim: true }) fed to the unmodified classifyIpAddress from src/orgunits/web/address.ts
prohibited: exposing institution hostnames during structural checks
disabling or special-casing any address-policy rule to make the check pass
treating the absence of contrary evidence as proof of a compliant vantage
networkPreconditionPersists.ifTheMachineIsAgainOnTheUnsuitableVantag: STOP before live execution. Consume no reserve and create no institution failure from that environment
networkPreconditionPersists.ifItFailsMidWindow: STOP before the next item, retain what ran as ENVIRONMENT evidence, create no replacement obligation from it and consume no reserve
